Did you know about the Rajah Brooke’s Birdwing? 🦋✨

One of the largest and most beautiful butterflies in the world — and you can spot it here at Sementra! 🌿

🦋 Bold black wings with striking metallic green bands
🦋 Named after James Brooke, the first White Rajah of Sarawak
🦋 A protected national icon in Malaysia
🦋 Found in rainforests of Peninsular Malaysia, Borneo & Sumatra — especially around Ulu Geroh near Gopeng (and yes, often seen right here in Sementra too!)

At #SementraNatureHotSpringResort, you might just catch these stunning butterflies gathering near our hot spring area — a magical sight not to be missed.

#SementraVibes #RajahBrooke #NatureInMalaysia #WeekendEscape #ButterflySpotting #HiddenGemsMalaysia
